app_copy.title: Fair review in minutes
app_copy.caption: If something goes wrong, an impartial review sorts it out.

job: Impartial, not adversarial. Neither figure is blamed and the beam is dead level. This is the hardest screen in the set — the subject attracts courtroom and robot imagery, both of which read as blame, which the voice spec forbids.

style.reference: Retro Halftone Editorial Line Illustration v1.0
style.medium: vector illustration emulating screen-print / risograph, flat paper grain, no gradients
style.line_work: heavy hand-inked black outlines 6-10px at 2048px canvas, moderate weight variation (thicker at joints and contact points), confident single-stroke, gently wobbly organic corners, rounded terminals, contours occasionally left open at intersections, minimal interior detail — 1 to 3 crease lines per shape
style.shading: coarse visible round halftone dots, ~45 LPI equivalent, 45 degree angle, ONE flat density per shape, never a gradient ramp
style.values: exactly three readable values — ground, halftone grey, solid black. Midtones are ALWAYS dithered dots, never flat grey.
style.figures: high abstraction, geometric anatomy, exaggerated elongated limbs, oversized hands and feet, mitten-simple fingers, small head relative to body, profile face with ONE curved-line eye, single bold nose and lip contour, no pupils, no nostrils, no ear detail, hair as a solid black graphic mass with a hard silhouette
style.value_separation: the two figures must be value-mirrored — one solid-black top over halftone trousers, the other halftone top over solid-black trousers — so neither reads as heavier or more guilty than the other
style.accent_marks: one small asterisk spark above the fulcrum. Nothing else.
style.ground_line: one long horizontal ink line anchoring the scene, no drawn floor and no furniture legs
style.composition: flat, no perspective, no horizon, no background scenery, at least 35% empty ground. Symmetrical here by exception — symmetry IS the message.
style.text_policy: NO text, letters, numbers or symbols rendered inside the image — the app renders all copy in Plus Jakarta Sans

casting.context: Ghanaian social commerce — sellers trading through WhatsApp and Instagram DMs, mobile money, hand-wrapped parcels
casting.represent: Ghanaian adults, 20s to 40s, everyday sellers and buyers running a business
casting.avoid: tribal-print decoration, huts, drums, wildlife, poverty signifiers, aid imagery, generic 'African' motifs
casting.tone_rule: Calm is the product. Neither figure may look accusatory, defensive or upset. Both stand upright and still.

scene.subject: two Ghanaian figures either side of a simple balance beam
scene.pose: both standing upright and calm, facing each other, each holding one item up at shoulder height with a single long arm
scene.wardrobe_values: left figure solid black shirt over halftone trousers; right figure halftone shirt over solid black trousers
scene.props: a plain horizontal beam resting on a narrow triangular fulcrum, perfectly level. Left figure holds a slab phone (plain solid black rectangle, no screen content). Right figure holds a wrapped parcel — halftone body, solid black tape cross.
scene.accent_marks: a single small asterisk spark floating above the fulcrum
scene.placement: beam and fulcrum centred, figures flanking, empty ground above

prompt: Retro mid-century editorial illustration on a flat #F1F1EF ground. Two Ghanaian figures stand facing each other on either side of a simple horizontal balance beam resting on a narrow triangular fulcrum — the beam perfectly level. The figure on the left, with a cropped afro, holds up a slab phone in one long arm; the figure on the right, with a high-top, holds up a wrapped parcel in one long arm. The left figure wears a solid black shirt with halftone trousers; the right figure wears a halftone shirt with solid black trousers. Both stand calm and upright, no aggression, no accusation. A single small asterisk spark floats above the fulcrum. Bold uneven hand-inked black outlines, flat solid black fills, coarse visible halftone dot shading, strictly three values, no color, no gradients, no soft shadows. Simplified geometric anatomy, exaggerated elongated limbs, oversized hands and feet, profile faces with one curved-line eye each and a bold minimal nose, solid black graphic hair. Single horizontal ground line. Square 1:1, generous negative space, screen-print risograph texture. No text anywhere in the image.
negative_prompt: flat grey fills instead of halftone dots
app UI on the phone screen
scales of justice with hanging pans and chains

caption_variant.when: social posts, App Store screenshots, landing page — NOT in-app
caption_variant.caption: dead level.
caption_variant.add_to_prompt: Large lowercase bold Helvetica Neue caption 'dead level.' set flush-left in the upper-left with very tight leading, generous margin from the edge, never overlapping the figures.

qa_checklist: The beam is DEAD LEVEL — any tilt implies a verdict and kills the screen
Neither figure reads as the accused; value-mirroring is intact
No courtroom, gavel, robot or magnifying-glass imagery crept in
Exactly three values present — no fourth grey
Every midtone is visibly dotted at 100% zoom
regeneration_note: Expect to regenerate this one most. If the model keeps producing hanging-pan scales, replace 'balance beam' with 'plain horizontal plank resting on a small triangular block, perfectly level' and re-run.
